source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 1025 stores OnDataAvailable's result when the MIME pipe is full and returns it on failure before retrying the write. Complete also returns the final listener result instead of always NS_OK. The accepted emitter keeps both changes. A failed downstream data callback must not be replaced by the success of a later write or unconditional completion. These are local return contracts; no stalled-pipe test or error callback execution was run.
title: Propagate the MIME listener result before retrying a blocked pipe write
